title: Charging down assets.
bodyText: The commissioner may require any asset on the books of a Hawaii financial institution to be charged down to such sum as represents its fair value.
bodyHtml: §412:3-109  Charging down assets.  The commissioner may require any asset on the books of a Hawaii financial institution to be charged down to such sum as represents its fair value. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
